papers.title: Autonomous Quantum Measurement with Agentic AI
papers.translated_title: 自主量子测量与代理式人工智能
papers.author: Eunbi Rha
papers.summary: Quantum materials exhibit diverse electronic and functional phenomena, but their characterization requires extensive experimental expertise, iterative decision-making and accumulated laboratory knowledge that is difficult to document and transfer. Here we introduce Quantum Agent (QUANTA), an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) framework for autonomous quantum-materials characterization. Using a widely adopted Physical Property Measurement System (PPMS) as an experimental platform, QUANTA combines retrieval augmentation using scientific literature, experimental protocols and prior measurements with specialized agents for experimental planning, troubleshooting, and data interpretation. A separate deterministic control layer validates instrument actions. Guided by incoming data, QUANTA evaluates measurement quality, revises experimental plans and selects subsequent measurements. We demonstrate these capabilities through transport measurements of the topological Weyl semimetal TaP, as well as investigations of nonlinear responses in magnetic material Co2MnGa. These results establish QUANTA as a generalizable framework for evidence-driven, safeguarded and closed-loop quantum-materials characterization.
papers.translated_summary: 量子材料展现出多样的电子与功能现象，但其表征需要大量实验专业知识、迭代决策以及难以记录和转移的实验室积累知识。在此，我们提出Quantum Agent（QUANTA），一种用于自主量子材料表征的智能体人工智能（AI）框架。以广泛采用的物理性质测量系统（PPMS）作为实验平台，QUANTA将基于科学文献、实验方案和先前测量数据的检索增强与用于实验规划、故障排除和数据解读的专用智能体相结合。一个独立的确定性控制层对仪器操作进行验证。在传入数据的引导下，QUANTA评估测量质量、修订实验计划并选择后续测量。我们通过拓扑Weyl半金属TaP的输运测量以及对磁性材料Co2MnGa中非线性响应的研究展示了这些能力。这些结果确立了QUANTA作为证据驱动、安全防护和闭环量子材料表征的通用框架。

papers.title: Discovery of Diverse and Realistic Financial Tail-Risk Using Generative Flow Networks
papers.translated_title: 使用生成流网络发现多样且逼真的金融尾部风险
papers.author: Adir Serruya
papers.summary: Accurate modeling of rare, high-impact financial events is essential for robust risk management. Sampling-based techniques such as Sequential Markov Chain Monte Carlo (SMCMC) generate diverse scenarios but inefficiently explore high-risk regions, while Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) converges on narrow sets of scenarios, limiting diversity. We present GRID, which uses Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) -- samplers that draw objects in proportion to a reward -- to systematically generate diverse and realistic financial tail-risk scenarios. Building on continuous GFlowNets, GRID introduces a flexible mixture-policy architecture with variable-specific distribution families for high-dimensional, sequential macro-financial data, together with plausibility constraints that keep generated trajectories realistic. A central practical advantage is robustness to reward-proxy imperfection: because GFlowNets sample proportionally rather than maximize, they remain broadly exploratory even when the oracle's out-of-sample accuracy is low -- an unavoidable reality in financial forecasting. On three real-world crises, GRID improves scenario diversity, realism, and tail-risk coverage over RL and MCMC baselines, and ablations over oracle architectures and distribution families yield practical insights into continuous GFlowNet behavior under noisy rewards.
papers.translated_summary: 准确建模罕见且高影响的金融事件对于稳健的风险管理至关重要。基于采样的技术，如序列马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（SMCMC），能够生成多样化情景，但对高风险区域的探索效率低下；而深度强化学习（DRL）则收敛于狭窄的情景集合，限制了多样性。我们提出GRID，利用生成流网络（GFlowNets）——一种按奖励比例抽取对象的采样器——来系统性地生成多样化且逼真的金融尾部风险情景。GRID在连续GFlowNets的基础上，引入了一种灵活的混合策略架构，针对高维、序列化的宏观金融数据采用变量特定的分布族，并结合合理性约束以保持生成轨迹的逼真性。一个核心的实际优势是对奖励代理不完美的鲁棒性：由于GFlowNets是按比例采样而非最大化，即使预言机的样本外准确率较低——这是金融预测中不可避免的现实——它们仍能保持广泛的探索性。在三次真实世界危机中，GRID在情景多样性、逼真性和尾部风险覆盖方面优于RL和MCMC基线，而针对预言机架构和分布族的消融实验为噪声奖励下连续GFlowNet的行为提供了实用见解。

papers.title: What to randomize matters: a controlled study of volume, axis and representation in low-data molecular generation
papers.translated_title: 随机化什么很重要：低数据分子生成中体积、轴和表示的对照研究
papers.author: Neerav Kaushal
papers.summary: Chemical language models can struggle to generate new molecules when trained on small datasets, where a model may reproduce training examples rather than learn a useful generative distribution. Randomized SMILES augmentation varies atom traversal, whereas Sequential Attachment-based Fragment Embedding (SAFE) also allows the order of fragment blocks to vary. How these distinct sources of representational variation affect low-data molecular generation has not been clearly studied. Here, using 1,000 seed molecules to train an autoregressive sequence model, we compare canonical SAFE with randomized SAFE at increasing corpus sizes, isolate atom-order and fragment-order axes of SAFE randomization, and compare fully randomized SAFE with randomized SMILES at molecule-by-molecule matched training corpora. Three findings emerge. First, randomization of SAFE alone raises the genuine yield of novel molecules more than 450-fold, turning a model that merely reproduces its training set into a practical molecular generator. Second, the two axes of randomization act jointly rather than additively: atom order alone reaches a tenth, and fragment order alone a seventh, of the genuine yield obtained when both vary, which is four times their combined contribution. Third, at matched corpus size and compute, randomized SAFE delivers 2.8 times the genuine yield of randomized SMILES. Welch tests with Games-Howell post-hoc comparisons resolve every difference on the primary outcomes. In the low-data regime, thus, what one randomizes rather than only how much determines whether augmentation produces new molecules or merely new spellings of the training set.
papers.translated_summary: 化学语言模型在小数据集上训练时可能难以生成新分子，此时模型可能只是复现训练样本，而非学习到有用的生成分布。随机化SMILES增强改变了原子遍历顺序，而基于序列连接的片段嵌入（SAFE）还允许片段块的顺序发生变化。这些不同的表示变异来源如何影响低数据分子生成尚未得到清晰研究。本文使用1,000个种子分子训练一个自回归序列模型，在递增的语料规模下比较规范SAFE与随机化SAFE，分离SAFE随机化的原子顺序轴与片段顺序轴，并在逐分子匹配的训练语料上比较完全随机化SAFE与随机化SMILES。研究得出三项发现。第一，仅对SAFE进行随机化即可将新分子的真实产率提高450倍以上，使一个仅复现训练集的模型转变为实用的分子生成器。第二，两个随机化轴共同作用而非简单相加：仅原子顺序达到两个轴同时变化时真实产率的十分之一，仅片段顺序达到七分之一，而两者同时变化的效果是二者单独贡献之和的四倍。第三，在匹配语料规模和计算量下，随机化SAFE的真实产率是随机化SMILES的2.8倍。Welch检验结合Games-Howell事后比较解决了主要结局上的所有差异。因此，在低数据情形下，随机化什么而不仅仅是随机化多少，决定了增强是产生新分子还是仅仅产生训练集的新拼写。

papers.title: Discovering Jailbreaks via Curriculum of Models
papers.translated_title: 通过模型课程发现越狱方法
papers.author: Michał Burzyński
papers.summary: Automated jailbreak discovery aims to find prompts that elicit prohibited behaviors from safety-trained language models, helping developers identify vulnerabilities before deployment. One class of approaches uses reinforcement learning to train an investigator model to generate prompts that elicit a specified behavior from a target model. However, training directly against a safety-trained target is difficult because nearly all prompts are refused, leaving the investigator with a sparse reward signal. Prior work addresses this with the propensity bound (PRBO), a proxy reward estimated by sampling responses from a more compliant target, and then adjusting for how likely those responses would have been under the original target. We introduce Curriculum of Models (CoM), an alternative method that trains the investigator against a sequence of modified versions of the target, progressing gradually from a version that readily exhibits the specified behavior to the original target. For jailbreak discovery, training begins against a target version that rarely refuses harmful requests, and advances to the next, harder version once the investigator reliably elicits the behavior from the current one. We evaluate CoM on elicitation tasks involving CBRN materials, explosives, and illicit drugs, using two open-weight targets, gemma-4-31b-it and gpt-oss-120b. We compare against PRBO and direct training on the original target without a curriculum. When the investigator is trained to elicit a single behavior, CoM finds successful jailbreaks more reliably than either baseline. When trained on multiple behaviors simultaneously, the CoM-trained investigator can elicit held-out behaviors, though PRBO-trained investigators achieve higher success rates. Our results suggest that a simple curriculum over target models offers a promising approach for addressing sparse rewards in rare-behavior elicitation.
papers.translated_summary: 自动化越狱发现旨在寻找能够诱导经过安全训练的语言模型产生被禁止行为的提示，帮助开发者在部署前识别漏洞。一类方法使用强化学习训练一个调查者模型，使其生成能够从目标模型诱导出指定行为的提示。然而，直接针对经过安全训练的目标进行训练是困难的，因为几乎所有提示都会被拒绝，导致调查者只能获得稀疏的奖励信号。先前的工作通过倾向性边界（PRBO）来解决这一问题，该方法通过从一个更顺从的目标中采样回复来估计代理奖励，然后根据这些回复在原始目标下出现的可能性进行调整。我们引入了模型课程（CoM），这是一种替代方法，它针对目标的一系列修改版本训练调查者，从容易表现出指定行为的版本逐步过渡到原始目标。对于越狱发现，训练从很少拒绝有害请求的目标版本开始，一旦调查者能够可靠地从当前版本诱导出该行为，就推进到下一个更难的版本。我们在涉及CBRN材料、爆炸物和非法药物的诱导任务上评估了CoM，使用了两个开放权重目标：gemma-4-31b-it和gpt-oss-120b。我们与PRBO以及在没有课程的情况下直接对原始目标进行训练进行了比较。当调查者被训练来诱导单一行为时，CoM比任一基线都更可靠地找到成功的越狱。当同时训练多种行为时，CoM训练的调查者能够诱导出留出的行为，尽管PRBO训练的调查者取得了更高的成功率。我们的结果表明，对目标模型采用简单的课程为解决稀有行为诱导中的稀疏奖励问题提供了一种有前景的方法。

papers.title: Beyond Region Memory: Local Point Tracking for Vocal Cord Localization in Video Laryngoscopy
papers.translated_title: 超越区域记忆：用于视频喉镜中声带定位的局部点跟踪
papers.author: Huayu Wang
papers.summary: Reliable vocal-cord localization in emergency video laryngoscopy remains visually challenging due to rapid tissue deformation, specular highlights, and instrument occlusions. We propose Local Point Tracking (LPT), a robust framework that combines a single-frame detector, local point propagation, and stateless mask refinement. LPT follows a localize first, snap second pipeline. First, a single-frame semantic detector generates sparse anchors, within which LPT initializes local query points (SAM-supported by default, with a regular grid as fallback). A point-propagation module tracks these points through detector-missed frames and recovers temporal bounding boxes from their geometry. Second, because point-derived boxes can be loose around the visible boundary, a box-snap step refines the selected box to the target boundary. This decomposition keeps temporal state in local point coordinates rather than a stateful mask or whole-region representation, while the spatial refinement module handles single-frame boundary precision without feeding mask errors back into temporal memory. Extensive evaluations on two distinct datasets demonstrate that our proposed LPT method achieves strong overall performance against existing baselines, with the best mAP_50, success AUC, and missing rate on both datasets. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm that point tracking primarily enhances temporal tracking robustness, while box-snap refinement effectively improves boundary tightness.
papers.translated_summary: 在急诊视频喉镜检查中，可靠地定位声带在视觉上仍然具有挑战性，原因包括组织快速变形、镜面高光和器械遮挡。我们提出了局部点跟踪（Local Point Tracking，LPT），这是一个稳健的框架，结合了单帧检测器、局部点传播和无状态掩码细化。LPT遵循“先定位、后吸附”的流程。首先，单帧语义检测器生成稀疏锚点，LPT在其中初始化局部查询点（默认由SAM支持，并以规则网格作为回退方案）。点传播模块在检测器漏检的帧中跟踪这些点，并根据其几何形状恢复时序边界框。其次，由于由点推导出的边界框在可见边界周围可能较为松散，框吸附步骤将选定的框细化到目标边界。这种分解将时序状态保存在局部点坐标中，而不是有状态的掩码或全区域表示中，同时空间细化模块处理单帧边界精度，而不会将掩码误差反馈到时序记忆中。在两个不同数据集上的大量评估表明，我们提出的LPT方法在现有基线方法中取得了较强的整体性能，在两个数据集上均获得了最佳的mAP_50、成功AUC和漏检率。此外，消融研究证实，点跟踪主要增强了时序跟踪的稳健性，而框吸附细化有效提高了边界紧致度。

papers.title: Evaluating Visual Realism of AI-Generated Videos with Eye Tracking
papers.translated_title: 利用眼动追踪评估AI生成视频的视觉真实感
papers.author: Danqing Shi
papers.summary: Human evaluation of AI-generated videos has so far relied on explicit human feedback, such as judgments or ratings. While these signals capture the conclusions viewers reach, they fail to offer insights into the perception that leads to them. This paper investigates eye tracking as a complementary human evaluation signal for AI-generated videos. We conducted two Visual Turing Test (VTT) experiments with a total of 90 participants on videos generated by latest generative models, in which participants watched each video twice and then gave their feedback. Across the experiments, we collected 4,286 valid eye-tracking trials on 438 videos. Our analysis indicates that gaze patterns offer informative evaluation signals that align with explicit human feedback. Building on the findings, we propose the first computational method GazeEval to predict the perceived visual realism of AI-generated videos from eye-tracking data. It achieves 71.3% accuracy in prediction, providing evidence that eye tracking data carries informative signals about how people evaluate a video. We release the study data to support further research on eye tracking for evaluating AI-generated video.
papers.translated_summary: 迄今为止，对AI生成视频的人工评估一直依赖于显式的人类反馈，例如判断或评分。尽管这些信号捕捉到了观看者得出的结论，却无法提供对导致这些结论的感知过程的洞见。本文研究眼动追踪作为一种补充性的人工评估信号用于AI生成视频。我们针对最新生成模型生成的视频开展了两次视觉图灵测试（VTT）实验，共有90名参与者，参与者在实验中观看每个视频两次后给出反馈。在两次实验中，我们在438个视频上收集了4,286次有效的眼动追踪试验。我们的分析表明，注视模式提供了与显式人类反馈相一致的信息性评估信号。基于这些发现，我们提出了首个计算方法GazeEval，用于从眼动追踪数据预测AI生成视频的感知视觉真实感。该方法在预测中达到71.3%的准确率，提供了证据表明眼动追踪数据携带了关于人们如何评估视频的信息性信号。我们发布了研究数据，以支持关于眼动追踪用于评估AI生成视频的进一步研究。

papers.title: CopyLoop: Fast Looped Transformer Decoding via Context Copying and Shallow Screening
papers.translated_title: CopyLoop：通过上下文复制和浅层筛选实现快速循环Transformer解码
papers.author: Wenyu Du
papers.summary: Looped Transformers increase computational capacity through the repeated application of shared blocks, but their recurrent depth makes conventional full-depth decoding expensive. While existing speculative pipelines accelerate generation by processing consecutive token positions at varying depths, they are typically limited by sequential decoding overheads. We introduce CopyLoop, a training-free decoding algorithm that combines low-cost context-copy proposals with shallow screening and continuous recurrent scheduling. Rather than step-by-step generation, CopyLoop proposes multi-token suffixes from repeated context. It then evaluates them early at a shallow recurrent depth to efficiently filter out incorrect branches, processing newer blocks concurrently while earlier blocks are still progressing toward full-depth verification. We evaluate CopyLoop across six model checkpoints from the Ouro, Raven, and Huginn families, covering code generation and multi-step mathematical reasoning. CopyLoop achieves decoding speedups of 2.98x--10.70x over full-depth autoregressive decoding on Base models and 2.74x--3.52x on Thinking models, consistently outperforming or closely matching all competing baselines across evaluation tasks. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm a strong synergy between shallow screening and continuous scheduling, while our analyses show that CopyLoop requires only lightweight model calibration and yields greater speedups on longer generations with reusable contexts.
papers.translated_summary: 循环Transformer通过重复应用共享块来提升计算容量，但其循环深度使得传统的全深度解码变得昂贵。现有投机流水线通过在不同深度处理连续token位置来加速生成，但通常受限于顺序解码开销。我们提出CopyLoop，一种免训练的解码算法，将低成本上下文复制提案与浅层筛选和连续循环调度相结合。CopyLoop并非逐步生成，而是从重复上下文中提出多token后缀。随后在浅层循环深度上提前评估这些后缀，以高效过滤错误分支，在较早块仍在向全深度验证推进时并发处理较新的块。我们在来自Ouro、Raven和Huginn系列的六个模型检查点上评估CopyLoop，涵盖代码生成和多步数学推理。CopyLoop在Base模型上相比全深度自回归解码实现2.98倍至10.70倍的解码加速，在Thinking模型上实现2.74倍至3.52倍的加速，在所有评估任务上持续优于或接近所有竞争基线。此外，消融研究证实了浅层筛选与连续调度之间的强协同效应，而我们的分析表明CopyLoop仅需轻量级模型校准，并在具有可复用上下文的更长生成中产生更大加速。

papers.title: UnEZ: A Fully Unsupervised Self-Templating Neural Network for Redshift and Line Strength Estimation
papers.translated_title: UnEZ：一种用于红移和谱线强度估计的全无监督自模板神经网络
papers.author: Asha Abd
papers.summary: As spectroscopic surveys grow, estimating galaxy properties such as metallicity, star formation rate, and redshift becomes computationally cumbersome. Methods of estimating such properties rely on template spectra or curated redshift catalogs, which fail to represent the diversity of objects seen in large-scale surveys. We present UnEZ, a fully unsupervised, physics-informed machine learning model that can predict spectroscopic redshifts and line strengths with no prior redshift or line strength labels. An encoder predicts emission and absorption line amplitudes/widths, and a fixed deterministic decoder constructs a unique template, estimated redshift, redshift confidence curve, and spectral model. UnEZ was tested on the Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) Data Release 18 due to its large dataset and thoroughly vetted redshift catalog which serves as an independent benchmark. Despite the lack of templates, line strength labels, or redshift labels, UnEZ's performance competes with modern redshift estimation algorithms. At SNR > 10, UnEZ achieves an outlier fraction of 0.459% and a normalized median absolute deviation (NMAD) of $1.237 \times 10^{-4}$. At SNR > 3, UnEZ achieves an outlier fraction of 3.89% and an NMAD of $1.471 \times 10^{-4}$. Furthermore, we demonstrate how UnEZ's line strength and redshift predictions can be utilized for various purposes such as constructing template spectra required in traditional redshift estimation algorithms. UnEZ illustrates how a fully unsupervised neural network can allow redshift, among other galaxy properties, to emerge naturally from the spectra themselves, providing a template-free, label-free approach that scales to the demands of future surveys.
papers.translated_summary: 随着光谱巡天规模的扩大，估算金属丰度、恒星形成率和红移等星系属性在计算上变得愈发繁琐。估算此类属性的方法依赖于模板光谱或精选的红移星表，而这些无法代表大规模巡天中所见天体的多样性。我们提出UnEZ，一种完全无监督、融入物理信息的机器学习模型，能够在没有任何先验红移或谱线强度标签的情况下预测光谱红移和谱线强度。编码器预测发射线和吸收线的振幅/宽度，固定的确定性解码器构建唯一的模板、估计红移、红移置信曲线和光谱模型。由于斯隆数字巡天（SDSS）第18次数据发布具有庞大的数据集和经过充分验证的红移星表可作为独立基准，UnEZ在该数据上进行了测试。尽管缺乏模板、谱线强度标签或红移标签，UnEZ的性能仍可与现代红移估计算法相竞争。在SNR > 10时，UnEZ的离群率为0.459%，归一化中位绝对偏差（NMAD）为$1.237 \times 10^{-4}$。在SNR > 3时，UnEZ的离群率为3.89%，NMAD为$1.471 \times 10^{-4}$。此外，我们展示了如何将UnEZ的谱线强度和红移预测用于各种目的，例如构建传统红移估计算法所需的模板光谱。UnEZ说明了完全无监督的神经网络如何能够让红移及其他星系属性从光谱本身自然涌现，提供了一种可扩展到未来巡天需求的无模板、无标签方法。

papers.title: Causal Attention on CPU: A Cache-Aware and Load-Balanced Scheduling Kernel for Prefill
papers.translated_title: CPU上的因果注意力：一种面向预填充的缓存感知与负载均衡调度内核
papers.author: Kwun Fung Lau
papers.summary: Agentic AI drives significant productivity gains across diverse domains, but concurrent long-context prefills from multiple agents can saturate GPU compute resources. Although CPUs offer a viable alternative, existing CPU attention kernels fall short in adapting to multi-tier cache hierarchies and lack effective thread scheduling. To address this, we introduce CACPU, a high-performance attention kernel featuring tiered cache blocking and an in-kernel task dispatching mechanism designed for causal full-sequence prefilling. CACPU achieves up to a 2.01x speedup over PyTorch SDPA, FlexAttention, and SGLang attention kernels. Integrated into SGLang, it reduces Time to First Token (TTFT) of Llama-3.1-8B by up to 1.74x while preserving model accuracy.
papers.translated_summary: Agentic AI 在多个领域带来显著的生产力提升，但来自多个智能体的并发长上下文预填充可能使 GPU 计算资源饱和。尽管 CPU 提供了可行的替代方案，但现有的 CPU 注意力内核在适应多级缓存层次结构方面存在不足，且缺乏有效的线程调度。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 CACPU，一种高性能注意力内核，具备分层缓存分块和内核内任务调度机制，专为因果全序列预填充设计。CACPU 相比 PyTorch SDPA、FlexAttention 和 SGLang 注意力内核实现了最高 2.01 倍的加速。将其集成到 SGLang 中，可将 Llama-3.1-8B 的首令牌时间（TTFT）降低最高 1.74 倍，同时保持模型精度。

papers.title: Pinpointing Pivot Points: The DECIDE Framework for Data Analysis Decision Importances
papers.translated_title: 精准定位关键转折点：数据分析决策重要性的DECIDE框架
papers.author: Zachary T. Rewolinski
papers.summary: Human judgment calls made throughout the data science life cycle can change the conclusions drawn from data. Independent analysts often make different choices when given the same data, leading to often unacceptable variations in results and contributing to the ongoing reproducibility crisis across scientific disciplines. The rapid adoption of agentic tools threatens to amplify this crisis. Several approaches have been developed to address this variation by following the same strategy: repeating an analysis under different combinations of analytical decisions and inspecting the distribution of outcomes. Examples include multiverse analysis, specification curve analysis, and vibration of effects. More broadly, the Predictability-Computability-Stability (PCS) framework assesses how documented judgment calls across the data science life cycle affect conclusions, with predictability serving as a reality-check that a model captures signal. Each of these approaches results in a "multiverse" object. While the distribution of outcomes reflects the overall variability of conclusions, estimating the influence of each individual decision requires additional tools. A common heuristic is to train a model to predict the outcome from these decisions and treat its coefficients or feature importances as proxies for each decision's influence. Although this strategy may work in certain cases, it assumes the model is correctly specified and accurately predicts the outcome, which we show is not always the case. In this work, we introduce DECIDE, a model-free framework that quantifies each decision's importance from the actual outcomes across the plausible decision space, avoiding issues of predictability by design. We demonstrate the effectiveness of DECIDE by applying it to real-world multiverse analyses. We further provide what is, to our knowledge, the first formal definition of the multiverse.
papers.translated_summary: 在数据科学生命周期中，人为判断会影响从数据得出的结论。独立分析人员面对相同数据时常常做出不同选择，导致结果出现往往不可接受的变异，并加剧了各科学学科中持续存在的可重复性危机。智能体工具的快速采用有可能放大这一危机。为解决这种变异，已有若干方法被开发出来，它们遵循相同策略：在不同分析决策组合下重复分析，并检查结果的分布。示例包括多宇宙分析、规格曲线分析和效应振动。更广泛地说，可预测性-可计算性-稳定性框架评估数据科学生命周期中有记录的判断如何影响结论，其中可预测性作为一种现实检验，确认模型捕捉到了信号。这些方法都会产生一个“多宇宙”对象。虽然结果分布反映了结论的整体变异性，但估计每个单独决策的影响需要额外工具。一种常见启发式方法是训练一个模型从这些决策预测结果，并将其系数或特征重要性视为每个决策影响的代理。尽管该策略在某些情况下可能有效，但它假设模型被正确设定并能准确预测结果，而我们表明这并非总是如此。在这项工作中，我们引入DECIDE，一个无模型框架，它从合理决策空间中的实际结果量化每个决策的重要性，在设计上避免可预测性问题。我们通过将DECIDE应用于真实世界多宇宙分析来证明其有效性。我们进一步提供了据我们所知首个多宇宙的正式定义。
